title: this angle-map verdict was *invalidated*
dek: The first Research OS run used an older Angle Map canon after recent sessions had parked it as a primary offer. This visual remains at the original URL so the stale recommendation cannot keep circulating.

sections.heading: do not use the old verdict
sections.body:
Angle Map was explicitly parked as a primary offer in the recent task history. The prior report treated a polished historical artifact as newer authority and incorrectly returned Angle Map to the lead position.

The corrected run compares the 15-Ad Creative Test Pack, Lead-to-Proposal Proof Sprint, and health evidence-to-message workflow.

sections.heading: what the corrected run found
sections.dek: The winner depends on the stated objective; no local task lock is universal.

items.why: Lead-to-Proposal remains the stronger separate cash hypothesis.
Use the evidence-to-message or creative-intelligence workflow as a second rung after a paid delivery.
Preserve as supporting IP; do not market it as the active primary offer.

sections.heading: the corrected artifact
sections.body: The replacement includes the cross-session authority ledger, corrected tournament, ICP, avatar, paid and resisted problems, positioning, LinkedIn proof loop, AI pathway, and payment kill gates.
